name: wicked-brain
description: Plain-markdown memory vault for Codex: recall, save and maintain notes about projects, decisions, sessions and concepts, with ranked search, duplicate detection, freshness checks and optional encrypted cross-device sync.

interface.longDescription: Recall and save notes about your projects, decisions and people in a local markdown vault that Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity can all share. Runs entirely on your machine, with no account and no telemetry. Needs the free uv tool installed. Optional end-to-end-encrypted sync to a server you run.
defaultPrompt: Set up Wicked Brain with my vault.
What do we know about this project?
Save what we decided today to my vault.
